page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top: page number "106" at left, "EMBLEMA" centred above the title. Title "MALVM MALO DVPLICATVM" in large italic capitals across the top. Below it a framed engraving of ships at sea (no text). Below the engraving, a four-line verse set in italic, centred. At the lower right, a catchword "Multa" in the margin/foot.

p.i: Haud temere armaris Neptune bicuspide ferro
Nam duplici infestus clade, modoq; noces:
Quæ vos, mortales! eheu! dementia cœpit!
Non vnum satis est; nunc geminate malum!

page.notes: The engraving shows several galleys and sailing ships in a sea battle, with soldiers on decks and waves below; no printed text within it. The verse lines have a flourished initial H and Q. The word "Multa" at lower right is printed as a catchword, shown in the margin; the first verse line ends with a punctuation mark "ferro" with a small mark after it. Doubtful: "modoq;;" rendered as printed, "noces:" as printed.
